blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein dono taraf alag alag functions hain: left par sine aur right par cosine, aur angles bhi alag hain (\(3x\) aur \(2x\)).
Diya kya hai? Sirf equation \(\sin 3x = \cos 2x\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehle \([0, 2\pi]\) wale saare solutions, phir general solution (yani har mumkin jawab).
Rule kaunsa? Pehle cosine ko sine mein badlenge, phir \(\sin C - \sin D\) wala sum-to-product formula, jo minus ko product (zarb) bana deta hai.
Plan: product = 0 bana kar har factor ko alag alag zero rakhenge, dono cases hal karenge aur aakhir mein dekhenge ke koi jawab dobara to nahi aa raha.
Yaad rakhiye: jab angle \(5x\) jaisa ho to ek chakkar mein kai jawab aate hain, is liye ginti dhyan se karni hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin 3x = \cos 2x\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\cos\theta = \sin(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta)\) se dono taraf sine ban jayega. Phir \(\sin C - \sin D = 2\cos\frac{C+D}{2}\sin\frac{C-D}{2}\) lagayenge. Faida yeh hai ke minus (farq) ek product ban jata hai, aur product sirf tab zero hota hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. Is tarah ek mushkil equation do aasaan equations mein toot jati hai.
Aap soch rahe honge ke \(\sin 3x\) ko \(3\sin x - 4\sin^3 x\) bana kar bhi kar sakte hain; haan, magar woh raasta lamba hai aur us mein \(\sin\frac{\pi}{10}\) jaisi mushkil values aati hain. Sum-to-product wala raasta seedha hai.

Dono taraf sine banayein
\[\sin 3x = \sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2} - 2x\right)\]
\[\sin 3x - \sin\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2} - 2x\right) = 0\]
Kyun: complementary angles (woh do angles jin ka jama \(90^\circ\) ho) ka rule hai ke \(\cos\theta = \sin(\frac{\pi}{2} - \theta)\). Jab dono taraf ek hi function ho jaye to ek formula se dono terms jor sakte hain. Phir sab kuch left side par le aaye taa ke right side zero ho.

Angles ka aadha jama aur aadha farq
\[C = 3x,\quad D = \tfrac{\pi}{2} - 2x\]
\[\dfrac{C+D}{2} = \dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[\dfrac{C-D}{2} = \dfrac{5x}{2} - \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(C + D = 3x + \frac{\pi}{2} - 2x = x + \frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(C - D = 3x - \frac{\pi}{2} + 2x = 5x - \frac{\pi}{2}\). Formula mein yehi aadhe angles chahiye, is liye dono ko 2 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(C - D\) mein \(-(-2x) = +2x\) hota hai; yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

Equation ko product ki shakal dein
\[2\cos\left(\tfrac{x}{2} + \tfrac{\pi}{4}\right)\sin\left(\tfrac{5x}{2} - \tfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = 0\]
Yani \(\cos(\frac{x}{2} + \frac{\pi}{4}) = 0\) ya \(\sin(\frac{5x}{2} - \frac{\pi}{4}) = 0\).
Kyun: \(\sin C - \sin D = 2\cos\frac{C+D}{2}\sin\frac{C-D}{2}\). Ab do cheezon ka product zero hai; 2 to zero ho nahi sakta, is liye ya cosine wala factor zero hoga ya sine wala. Dono cases alag alag hal karenge.

Case 1: \(\cos\left(\frac{x}{2} + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = 0\)
\[\dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\]
\[\dfrac{x}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\]
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{2} + 2n\pi\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Kyun: ek chakkar mein \(\cos\theta = 0\) sirf \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par hota hai (y-axis par). Yeh dono \(\pi\) ke faasle par hain, is liye saare angles \(\frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\) hain. Phir \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) minus kiya aur 2 se multiply kiya; 2 se multiply karne par \(n\pi\) bhi \(2n\pi\) ban jata hai.
Aasaan alfaaz mein: angle ko aadha karne se jawab do guna door door ho jate hain, is liye \(n\pi\) ki jagah \(2n\pi\) aaya.

Case 2: \(\sin\left(\frac{5x}{2} - \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = 0\)
\[\dfrac{5x}{2} - \dfrac{\pi}{4} = n\pi\]
\[\dfrac{5x}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\]
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{10} + \dfrac{2n\pi}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\sin\theta = 0\) un angles par hota hai jo x-axis par hain: \(0, \pi, 2\pi, \ldots\), yani \(\theta = n\pi\). Phir \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) doosri taraf le gaye aur dono taraf ko \(\frac{2}{5}\) se multiply kiya: \(\frac{\pi}{4} \cdot \frac{2}{5} = \frac{\pi}{10}\) aur \(n\pi \cdot \frac{2}{5} = \frac{2n\pi}{5}\).
Yahan \(\frac{5}{2}\) ka ulta \(\frac{2}{5}\) hai; dono taraf usi se multiply karna parta hai taa ke akela \(x\) bache.

Case 2 ki values \([0, 2\pi]\) mein
\[n = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4:\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{10}, \tfrac{5\pi}{10}, \tfrac{9\pi}{10}, \tfrac{13\pi}{10}, \tfrac{17\pi}{10}\]
Kyun: har dafa \(\frac{2\pi}{5} = \frac{4\pi}{10}\) jurta hai, is liye numerator mein 4 barhta hai: 1, 5, 9, 13, 17. \(n = 5\) par \(\frac{21\pi}{10}\) aata hai jo \(2\pi = \frac{20\pi}{10}\) se bara hai, is liye ruk gaye. \(\frac{5\pi}{10}\) asal mein \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hai.
Dhyan dein: angle \(5x\) ho to ek chakkar mein paanch jawab aate hain; sirf \(n = 0\) le kar ruk jana aam ghalti hai.

Dono cases ko milayein
\[\tfrac{\pi}{2} + 2n\pi = \tfrac{\pi}{10} + \tfrac{2\pi}{5}(5n + 1)\]
Kyun: Case 1 ka har jawab Case 2 ki list mein pehle se maujood hai (Case 2 mein \(n\) ki jagah \(5n + 1\) rakh dein). Is liye Case 1 koi naya jawab nahi deta aur general solution ek hi family \(\frac{\pi}{10} + \frac{2n\pi}{5}\) hai. Agar aap kitab ki tarah paanchon values ke saath \(2n\pi\) likhein to bhi bilkul yehi set banta hai; bas ek line wala jawab chhota hai.
Misaal ke taur par \(n = 0\) lein: Case 1 deta hai \(\frac{\pi}{2}\), aur Case 2 mein \(n = 1\) bhi \(\frac{\pi}{10} + \frac{4\pi}{10} = \frac{\pi}{2}\) deta hai. Is liye ek hi value ko do dafa nahi likhte.

Tasdeeq: \(x = \frac{\pi}{10}\) (\(= 18^\circ\))
\[\sin 3x = \sin 54^\circ\]
\[\cos 2x = \cos 36^\circ = \sin 54^\circ \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cos 36^\circ = \sin(90^\circ - 36^\circ) = \sin 54^\circ\), to dono taraf barabar hain. Ek aur check \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par: \(\sin\frac{3\pi}{2} = -1\) aur \(\cos\pi = -1\), dono barabar \(\checkmark\).
Ek value check karna kaafi nahi samjhiye; exam mein kam az kam ek aisi value zaroor check karein jo doosre case se aayi ho.

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
